method: Real Django Client HTTP middleware/handlers in one process, persistent thread-local PG connections, no browser/Gunicorn/Caddy/external network. Actual seeded receipt/sale services. Shared server quiet window coordinated.

observer.note: SQL ledger acquisition duration includes lock wait + normal query cost. pg_stat_activity samples prove observed server Lock states; sampled span is not exact wait duration. Sampler itself adds local load.
